name: shorter-hourly-indicator-periods
rationale: src/backtest/simulator.rs::Simulator::run feeds compute_indicators() only the exact [from,to] candle slice requested by --from/--to (confirmed by reading the code 2026-09-07) — there is no pre-holdout warmup buffer fetched beforehand. With the default sma_period=200 (hours) and a 336-hour (14-day) holdout window, SMA alone cannot return Some until candle #200, consuming ~60% of the entire holdout before compute_btc_target's SMA-cross sub-signal is ever active; ema_period=100, macd_slow=104, and bollinger_period=60 also eat deep into the same window. This structurally starves the holdout of active-signal candles regardless of which direction the market moves. Shortening every period to standard hourly-timeframe values (RSI 14, MACD 12/26/9, Bollinger 20, SMA/EMA halved) leaves the large majority of the 336-candle window available for an active signal, which should produce a statistically meaningful trade count without touching compute_btc_target's formula at all.
